ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
spharmgrid (spherical harmonic gridding) implements spherical harmonic
filtering, regridding, differential operators, and atmospheric kinematics
for global Xarray fields, JAX arrays, and PyTorch tensors. It computes
relative vorticity, divergence, streamfunction, velocity potential,
Helmholtz decomposition, and inverse wind transforms.

about.description:
spharmgrid (spherical harmonic gridding) implements spherical harmonic
filtering, regridding, differential operators, and atmospheric kinematics

name: spharmgrid
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.4.1"

package:
  name: spharmgrid
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/s/spharmgrid/spharmgrid-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ad40b0bf2aa8d33cce158570d322ba7d52a640e4ca6d540672d2548b4b729be4

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - spharmgrid = spharmgrid.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling >=1.32.4
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - ducc0 >=0.39.0
    - numpy >=1.24.0
    - xarray >=2025.1.1
  run_constraints:
    - cf-xarray >=0.10.4
    - dask-core >=2024.1.0
    - h5netcdf >=1.8.1
    - h5py >=3.11.0
    - zarr >=3.0.0
    - cfgrib >=0.9.15
    - python-eccodes >=2.48.0
    - jax >=0.5.0
    - torch-harmonics >=0.9.3
    - pytorch >=2.13.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - spharmgrid
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - spharmgrid --help

about:
  summary: Spherical harmonic tools for filtering, regridding, and kinematics in atmospheric science with Xarray, PyTorch, and JAX
  description: |
    spharmgrid (spherical harmonic gridding) implements spherical harmonic
    filtering, regridding, differential operators, and atmospheric kinematics
    for global Xarray fields, JAX arrays, and PyTorch tensors. It computes
    relative vorticity, divergence, streamfunction, velocity potential,
    Helmholtz decomposition, and inverse wind transforms.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/spharmgrid/
  documentation: https://spharmgrid.readthedocs.io/
  repository: https://github.com/mwyau/spharmgrid

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mwyau
